Message from you:
How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
A
Message from Alen Customer Experience Team:
To get the best results from your BreatheSmart 45i: 
Run it continuously, as the recommended filter life is based on 24/7 operation.
Use Auto mode so it can adjust speed based on real-time air quality.
Choose the filter that matches your concern: Essential (Pure) for dust and allergens, Advanced (Fresh) for smoke, chemicals, and VOCs, or Ultimate (Odor) for odors, smoke, pollutants, and pet-filled homes.
Replace the filter every 9–12 months with normal use, or sooner when the Filter Life Indicator turns red. After replacing it, hold the FILTER button for approximately 5 seconds while the unit is on to reset the indicator.
When installing a replacement, keep the prefilter and pull tabs facing you, with the filter’s arrow pointing inward and the TOP label at the top.
The 45i captures up to 99.9% of particles 0.1 micron or larger and is designed to clean spaces up to 800 square feet every 30 minutes or 1,600 square feet every hour on the highest setting.
